output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.toolTip: Directory where rendered images will be saved

width.label: Image Width (px)
width.toolTip: Image width in pixels; the height follows the aspect ratio of the Avogadro view

samples.label: Samples per Pixel
samples.toolTip: More samples reduce noise but take longer

detail.label: Geometry Detail
detail.toolTip: Tessellation of spheres and bonds; use High for large close-up atoms

material.label: Material
material.toolTip: Surface appearance of atoms and bonds

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.toolTip: Studio: soft key light with an environment fill. Avogadro-like: flat light from above and in front, as in the Avogadro window

transparent.label: Transparent Background
transparent.toolTip: Write an alpha channel with a transparent background

backend.label: Backend
backend.toolTip: Auto picks the fastest available: CUDA, Metal, LLVM, then scalar CPU
